items.html: And behold, Daat is the first king that came out, and in him were included all the seven as mentioned above. And you already know that the essential raising of Mayin Nukvin are the vessels that were already born in the world, and therefore the essential raising of Mayin Nukvin until now was through Daat, who had already come out into the world first, for we have already explained that at first Mayin Nukvin were not needed for AVI, only Sliq be-Ra'ava (rising in desire) alone. And when it is said that these seven kings were Mayin Nukvin, the intention is not that they drew down Hesed-Gevura, for these had already been drawn down at first. And the proof of this is that AVI returned to Panim be-Panim, and afterward Hochma was given to Bina by these seven kings, as said; so it cannot be said that they were Mayin Nukvin to Bina. Rather, the intention is that they established them in the aspect of Panim be-Panim for AVI, through their raising of Mayin Nukvin, after they were already in Bina, and then they drew down again the Hesed-Gevura as at first. And let us return to the matter: after the light of Daat came out and entered into its vessel, it raised Mayin Nukvin, and drew down Hesed-Gevura into AVI, for indeed Daat is composed of Hesed-Gevura. And furthermore, the seven kings were then included within it, and therefore it had the power to bring down Hesed-Gevura as said. But since the other kings do not raise Mayin Nukvin, because their emergence had not yet reached beyond Daat, therefore it is not possible to bring down complete Mochin except through ZON together, and therefore what Daat brought down was only in the aspect of Hesed-Gevura in the Rosh and AVI Ila'in, in the place of their Daat, which resembles it, like it.
